_doc: Classification table for gen-portal-definitions.mjs. Source: proposals MCP_PORTAL_ESTATE.md section 5 (portal audiences) plus live evidence GET 2026-11-23 and operator decisions D7 (caller pass-through) and D8 (legal + finance domain portals). Every snapshot server is placed, parked (defined, in no portal, status active) or unclassified with a reason; unclassified is expected to be empty.

mirror_reasons.chode: Code-mode portal (live GET 2026-11-23: code_mode default_on, description "Chitty Code Mode", 59 servers); D6 exception: may carry every placed server.
mirror_reasons.chittymcp-vm: Headless service-access portal (live GET 2026-11-23: code_mode opt_in, description "Service Access - Headless", 58 servers); mirrors chitty-mcp membership by design (reason recorded).

chitty-mcp.audience: operator core: ChittyOS control-plane agents (legal and finance agents moved to the legal and finance domain portals, D8)

chittycomms.description: Messaging MCP, Quo, imessage, twillio, and others coming soon

chode.audience: code-mode connector (claude.ai Chitty Code-Mode); carries every placed server

chittymcp-vm.audience: headless service access; mirror of chitty-mcp membership

legal.description: Legal domain portal: evidence, dispute, contextual

finance-portal.description: Finance domain portal: finance (portal id finance-portal because id finance collides with the finance server id)

groups.reason: ChittyOS control-plane agent (section 5 chitty-mcp list); ch1tty and secrets placed here by operator decision 2026-11-23 (unclassified -> placement)
Legal domain agent (D8: leaves chitty-mcp for the legal portal; matter isolation still enforced by the agent)
Finance domain agent (D8: leaves chitty-mcp for the finance portal)

parked.buyflow: Zero-tool server, never synced; operator did not decide, so parked (defined, in no portal), not retired.
parked.bridge-consent: Zero-tool server, never synced; operator did not decide, so parked (defined, in no portal), not retired.
parked.availability: Zero-tool server, never synced; operator did not decide, so parked (defined, in no portal), not retired.
parked.google: Duplicate upstream of gws (agent.chitty.cc/google/mcp), 0 portals; operator did not decide, so parked (defined, in no portal), not retired.
